summary.text: Kevin Hartke is a Republican candidate for Arizona House of Representatives District 13 (2 seats) in the November 3, 2026 general election and the mayor of Chandler, Arizona, a post he has held since January 2019.
He is a pastor by profession and did not run for re-election as mayor in 2026.

paragraphs.text: Kevin Hartke earned a B.A. in agricultural biochemistry from the University of Missouri and an M.A. in theology from Fuller Theological Seminary, according to Ballotpedia.
His professional experience includes working as lead pastor at Trinity Christian Fellowship.
Hartke served on the Chandler City Council from 2011 to 2019 before taking office as mayor on January 10, 2019, succeeding Jay Tibshraeny.
His term as mayor ends in 2027.
